title: Internal analytics batch failing after deploy — no customer surface, low CIS

ground_truth.summary: Deploy v1.8.0 to analytics-batch-service introduced a regression in the nightly-aggregation SQL — the batch job fails on empty partitions. events-loader (which also reads from the shared warehouse but did NOT get the deploy) still runs clean, proving the fault is the deploy, not the warehouse. Same mechanism as INC-4479, but this incident is internal-only and low-priority per customer_impact. Together the two bundles prove CIS deprioritises correctly regardless of diagnostic mechanism.

customer_impact.impact_source: internal analytics dashboard delayed — 25 engineering / product users see stale numbers
customer_impact._note_for_authors: Contrast case for INC-4479. Same mechanism, same root-cause type, but no customer surface. CIS should be ~5 (P3 base) + 0.05 (users) = ~5.05 → 'low' urgency. Proves the customer-impact score correctly deprioritises this incident even though the diagnostic verdict is identical shape.
